description: Make print-ready business cards from a person's details and get a link to order them. Designprint fills one of its own card designs (front and back, 3.5 x 2 in). Before calling, ask the user for their name and how to reach them (phone, email or website); title, company, tagline, address and a logo are optional. Returns a preview of both sides, the price (with shipping options and an estimated total when you pass a quantity) and one link where the user approves the card, picks a quantity and pays as a guest (no account). Call it once per card. To change a detail, the design or the color afterwards, call update_business_card with the link: the card keeps its link. Calling create_business_card again makes a second card with a different link. The job is finished only when the user has paid: after they say they have, call check_order to confirm. Use this when the user has named a design or asked for one card. If they have not chosen a design, call show_card_designs instead: it shows every design with their details, to choose from.

accent_color.description: Hex color that replaces the design's accent, e.g. '#0E7C66'. Use the brand color if the user has one.

channel.description: Where the request comes from, e.g. 'claude', 'chatgpt', 'cursor', 'terminal'.

logo_url.description: https link to a logo image (PNG, JPG or SVG). Shown on the back and small on the front. If it cannot be loaded the card is made without it and the warnings say so.

name.description: Full name as it should appear on the card.

phone.description: Phone number, written the way it should print.

quantity.description: How many cards the user wants, if they said. There is a minimum order; a smaller number is raised to the minimum and the change is reported in the warnings. With a quantity, the result also gives the shipping options and an estimated total. It is preselected on the order page.

style.description: Card design. Defaults to classic. The designs by look (a design can have two): minimal: classic, frame, line, soft, center, dots, badge, mono, grove, lagoon, summit, studio, sage, sprout; classic: classic, monogram, corner, initial, warm, stripe, ivory, laurel, marine, quill, capital, linen, claret; elegant: frame, noir, arch, monogram, line, center, onyx, initial, ivory, laurel, quill, petal, crest, regent, orchid, seal, gilt, blush, claret; modern: slant, banner, wave, dusk, bold, corner, sidebar, dots, stripe, split, midnight, tide, forge, summit, nightfall, studio, grid; bold: slant, banner, dusk, bold, sidebar, badge, split, ember, marine, forge, carbon, poppy, coral, volt, hazard, flare; friendly: arch, wave, soft, warm, ember, grove, lagoon, tide, petal, capital, orchid, poppy, coral, linen, blush, sage, sprout, flare; dark: noir, onyx, midnight, crest, regent, nightfall, signal, carbon, terminal, seal, gilt, volt, hazard, blueprint; technical: mono, signal, terminal, grid, blueprint. Each one is pictured at https://thedesignprint.com/business-cards/templates and described in one line by GET https://thedesignprint.com/v1/business-cards/styles.

tagline.description: Short line shown under the company name on the back of the card.
